_about: Weather forecast record (List 20 #194) — the derivation #172's registered clarification presupposes: forecasts exist only where a derivation backs them. A forecast is the #61+#142 derivation evaluated at a future clock position; it stores nothing about the world. The fragment instances no forecast.

basis.derived: area/global derivation from current state — an expectation, valid for the stated horizon
basis.rule: delivery copy may never upgrade a basis — a weighted projection may not be worded as a promise
basis.scripted: target weather fixed by script priority (#19: script > area > global) — exact; may be stated as fact
basis.weighted: climate weights (#142) rule the window — a likelihood, worded as one

cost: null — free device function vs keeper's service (#132/#20) is an owner ruling; the derivation is identical either way

delivery.broadcast: #172's weather class carries forecasts verbatim from this derivation (one function, #124 — media announces only what the derivation produces)
delivery.device: proposed `forecast` screen class into #149's home — its four classes are closed (identify/map/scan/alert); until accepted there, device delivery is spec-level

forecast.horizon: beats ahead — accuracy narrows toward the present and toward scripted basis
possiblePhenomena: #153 phenomenon ids whose conditions are projected to gather — POSSIBILITIES only; a forecast never asserts occurrence, and phenomenon records gain no forecast field
forecast.projectedState: #61 vocabulary: CLEAR | OVERCAST | RAIN | STORM | MIST | FROST | NONE
forecast.targetWindow: #19 phase range at a future clock position

theDepths: the Dark Forest depths are weather NONE at every clock position (#61/#142 hard canon) — a forecast naming the depths with any other state is a data error
